title: 1987 Donruss Diamond Kings #1 Mark McGwire Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1991 Fleer Mark McGwire baseball card from the Diamond set. It features McGwire as a player for the New York Yankees, card number 11. The card is not autographed and is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) league.
